description: Reconcile physical storage reports and retained pagination across a backend restart.
preconditions: State and read-only Distribution inspection are configured for this isolated release.
assertions: A completed report with collection cost evidence is required; unavailable accounting is a failure.
Internal storage inventory output contributes category totals and usage without generating object details.
Detailed object and category totals agree for each supported category, including the uploaded manifest, config and layer.
Registry totals match an independent filesystem metadata scan.
Dependency task and intent observations match their detail endpoints for the same IDs.
Retained reports remain immutable across restart.

checks.description: Enumerate both domains and reconcile every observed physical object and category.
Compare dependency task and intent observations with their detail endpoints.
Read the same immutable report after a backend restart.

outputs: Snapshot identity, domain totals, enumerated objects, usage groups, dependency observation evidence and restart evidence.
